Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District is inviting bids to supply 50,000 Tier 1 Small Student Chromebook Laptops (Touch), 50,000 Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook Laptops (Non‑Touch), and 50,000 Student Tablets. The final bid deadline, after addenda, is July 9, 2024, 2:00 PM CDT. Proposals must be submitted electronically through the iSupplier portal or as a sealed envelope containing one original hard copy mailed via FedEx/UPS; fax or email are not accepted, and only one submission format is required. Key requirements include a 3‑year minimum warranty on all Windows devices, white glove deployment services with asset decaling, asset reporting, etching for laptops, and delivery coordinated with the ED Tech department, along with INTERLOCAL AGREEMENT ("Rider") CONSENT FORM and FORM 1295 as mandatory documentation. Payment will be made within 10 days of receipt, the contract will run for an initial 3 years with two one‑year renewal options not to exceed five years, and bids will be processed through the Educational Purchasing Cooperative of North Texas (EPCNT) and Central Texas Purchasing Alliance (CTPA).
